Banner.Description: I am a DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineer with several years of experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure and deployment pipelines for large-scale enterprise systems. My expertise spans Kubernetes (GKE), CI/CD automation, application modernization, observability, and security. I specialize in transforming complex legacy environments into automated, reliable, and scalable platforms.
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I am a DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineer with several years of experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure and deployment pipelines for large-scale enterprise systems.
My work spans cloud and Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, application modernization, observability, and security and governance.
My core strength is turning complex, legacy environments into automated, observable, and reliable systems without disrupting business operations.
I continuously focus on improving systems, automating workflows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams including developers, SREs, infrastructure, and security teams.
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Sections.Title: Cloud & Kubernetes Platform Engineering
Content: Designing Kubernetes architectures using Deployments, StatefulSets, Jobs, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.
Containerizing applications including microservices and monolithic systems using Docker best practices such as multi-stage builds and externalized configuration.
Integrating systems with external databases, message brokers, and schedulers using secure configurations.
Implementing scalability and resilience using resource tuning, probes, and autoscaling.
Supporting microservices and troubleshooting issues related to networking, DNS, and configuration.
Guiding migrations from VM-based systems to Kubernetes clusters.

Experience.Sections.Title: CI/CD, Build Engineering & Release Automation
Content: Designing and maintaining CI pipelines using Bamboo including build, test, and packaging stages.
Building Docker images and managing artifacts for deployment.
Implementing GitOps-based CD using ArgoCD with environment configurations stored in Git.
Enabling automated sync, drift detection, and self-healing deployments.
Migrating from static build agents to ephemeral Kubernetes-based agents.
Creating custom agent images with required tools and dependencies.
Using shared persistent storage (PVC) for caching dependencies and improving performance.

Experience.Sections.Title: Observability, Performance & Reliability (SRE)
Content: Implementing monitoring and dashboards for CI systems including build metrics, agent utilization, and failure rates.
Setting up logging and metrics collection for Kubernetes workloads.
Creating dashboards for real-time visibility and performance analysis.
Handling production incidents and performing root cause analysis.
Improving reliability by refining deployment and monitoring strategies.

Experience.Sections.Title: Security, IAM & Governance
Content: Managing cloud IAM roles and service accounts using least-privilege principles.
Handling secrets securely using environment variables and secret management tools.
Administering repository access and enforcing branch protections.
Performing vulnerability remediation by updating images and dependencies.
Ensuring compliance with enterprise security requirements.

Experience.Sections.Title: Collaboration & Agile Delivery
Content: Working closely with developers, infrastructure teams, SREs, and security teams.
Participating in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Leading initiatives such as CI migrations and system modernization.
Documenting best practices and reusable patterns for teams.
